selected_evidence.requirement: Firewall permits SSH and TCP 8080 only, persistent config
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline zone config captured, cockpit/dhcpv6-client removed, ssh+8080/tcp added permanently and reloaded; runtime and --permanent listings both show only services: ssh, ports: 8080/tcp

selected_evidence.requirement: Unrelated inbound connections are rejected (not just default-accept)
selected_evidence.summary: nft ruleset shows filter_IN_public_allow explicitly accepting tcp dport 22 and 8080, with filter_IN_public falling through to reject with icmpx admin-prohibited for all else

selected_evidence.requirement: Functional proof that 8080 is reachable and unrelated ports are rejected
selected_evidence.summary: Live http.server on 8080 returned HTTP 200 via curl; port 9999 returned curl exit 7 (connection refused); test listener cleanly stopped
Captured boot_id 8c28f3cd-ef9b-4edb-b26e-9a7a6f76c879, firewalld active+enabled, sshd active before restart
Backgrounded systemctl reboot command acknowledged with 'reboot scheduled' before the node disconnected

selected_evidence.requirement: Node actually restarted (changed boot identity), not just delayed
selected_evidence.summary: First poll still showed old boot_id, next poll timed out (node down mid-reboot), then reconnect showed new boot_id 74e3d244-2aa7-4290-ab74-484fefed7be7, proving a real restart

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of firewall config and required services
selected_evidence.summary: After reboot, firewalld active+enabled with identical persisted rules (ssh, 8080/tcp only) and sshd active; live functional retest confirmed 8080 reachable (200) and port 9999 refused (exit 7), matching pre-restart behavior
